rootPolicyReceived: LocalGlobal only publish; slot=LayoutScope+LayoutNodeId, Public content only inside outlet and Subject exact triple; independent media primary originals1GiB (separate from classroom material originals2GiB); per-node document; current+one previous version; persistent latest acceptance sequence and separate page/view revision. This supersedes initial suggestions about teacher writes or a shared primary quota.
reusable: Existing sole StorageWriter TransactionTask/TransactionDocuments, owned Clock, exact SessionGuard and authority publisher: evaluate/precommit permissions and same-COMMIT content/receipt/catalog/ref accounting.

profiles catalog pages64/list20, stable scoped node IDs and independent document revisions. Profiles select only the exact currently authorized class/subject/effective teacher; keep that resolver rather than borrowing another material owner or retained-break source.
strict codec64KiB BLOB, recursive duplicate/unknown/depth/count guards, bounded scan_prefix128 entries/512KiB. Store independent node bodies and bounded catalogs, not full content in one profile.

ControlledFiles/SelectedFile/LockedFile/NewFile APIs: source pin,32KiB bounded copy/hash, durable seal, no-reparse/hardlink checks and immutable controlled rename; keep the prepared pin through DB commit and preserve files when commit result is unknown.
Material flow separates file preparation from writer and has original-retire/exclusive-delete/finalize pattern. Reuse the pattern, not its material-specific ownership schema or Shell open semantics.

WIC image.validate_image uses one decoder slot, trusted Microsoft container check, one frame,10MiB and8MP checks before scanline allocation, PBGRA full validation,64KiB explicit tile buffer, cancellation/CPU/wall limits. It currently returns metadata only and retains no display pixels.

Existing text validation handles strict UTF8 and BOM UTF16 including surrogate/block boundaries. It validates the stream but does not expose a normalized String; a bounded extraction API is still required for TXT node import.

Round17 CardBodySpec/NativeTextMeasure shared geometry can serve SubjectText. Images require distinct typed media content and stable node-specific geometry; material filename rows/thumbnails are not image components.
mustNotReuseAsIs: materials.ResourceInventory has material_id/scope and enforces references<=1. Attaching a profile image to it without generalizing every startup/GC invariant would permit wrong deletion or fail validation. Narrow change: separate profile-media namespace/registry and no physical cross-kind dedup this round.

material TXT import allows material-size inputs; subject text must independently enforce10000 Unicode scalar values and40KiB UTF8, normalize line endings explicitly, reject malformed encoding/control characters and never truncate or decode lossy.

WIC validate_image is not a display decoder or cache. Add bounded target-size pixel preparation over the same pinned validated source; do not expose IWIC objects cross-thread or put source paths in Scene.

Current layout Solver.spec and WidgetMeasure uniqueness use WidgetKind; Scene grouping uses component_kind and SubjectText/Image returnNone. Multiple independent content nodes require exact SceneNodeKey lookup, node-specific content/style, and node/revision-specific page events.
200MiB rebuildable media cache is not the only copy of an original. Active/current/previous media source files remain primary durable data; cache eviction must never destroy those sources.

suggestedPureModelAlignment.slot: ContentSlotKey{scope:LayoutScope,node_id:LayoutNodeId}; writer proves current public outlet membership or selected exact Subject triple and node kind.
suggestedPureModelAlignment.version: ContentVersion{revision,payload:Empty|Text(String)|Images(Vec<MediaReference>),last_actor_id,updated_at}; ordered images1..50; each ref has opaque media version ID/hash/bytes/dimensions/format, no path/pixels.
suggestedPureModelAlignment.style: LayoutDocument and SubjectProfileDocument hold bounded per-node ContentNodeStyle metadata, not full bodies. Match node_id/kind exactly; ALL stays eight builtins, new SubjectText/Image kinds are independent scoped content.
suggestedPureModelAlignment.limits: Text10000scalars/40KiBUTF8; image10MiB/8MP; image document1..50 ordered pages; one previous content version and explicit global catalog/resource cardinality caps in addition to byte quotas. Do not silently drop retained versions or pages to fit.

proposedBackendFacade: read_profile_content(lease, slot) -> ProfileContentDocument: fresh exact LocalGlobal Manage; no unauthenticated state() read used as a management facade.

begin_profile_content(lease, BeginContentRequest{command_id,slot,expected_revision,operation,payload_fingerprint,expires_at}) -> opaque ContentAdmissionTicket; sequence/current-CAS authorization stored before async work, current visible content remains unchanged.

prepare_profile_content(ticket, selected input, cancellation) -> opaque PreparedProfileContent: trusted worker preparation port, private fields bind ticket/slot/sequence/expected revision/actor and immutable verified refs or text; no constructor from UI path/JSON.

finish_profile_content(lease, PreparedProfileContent) -> ProfileContentDocument: same writer checks exact pending command/fingerprint/sequence/CAS, fresh lease/node membership and role, media registry/quota/ref transitions, receipt and authority publication.
fail_profile_content(lease or trusted canceled ticket, admission) -> outcome: only settles that original pending work; latest sequence never rolls backward and current content remains unchanged.

clear_profile_content and undo_profile_content: either use begin+finish operation variants or immediate same-writer commands; captured current revision/target previous revision required, emit a new content revision and reference updates atomically.

page_profile_content(management lease OR trusted current-scene capability, PageContentRequest{slot,expected_content_revision,expected_view_revision,page}) -> view state: page0..len-1, independent view CAS, no content mutation or manager-session renewal.
profile_content_outcome(command_id, actor/current lease) -> sender-authorized receipt: exact original result, not current visible state; no automatic resubmission after unknown COMMIT.
media_inventory(after,limit<=128) / retire_media(id,expected_registry_rev) / finalize_media_removal(ticket): trusted maintenance, bounded namespace, no external file I/O in writer.
publicationAlgorithm: Validate/capture the actual scoped node and expected content revision, then persist admission sequenceA using the unique writer; keep current/previous untouched.

Take a physical preparation owner on the shared finite worker pool. Open selected sources with controlled pinned handles, count pages and expected bytes before copying; reserve real pending bytes against the1GiB primary ledger.

For TXT, stream strict bounded decoding into the10000-scalar/40KiB string and canonical line endings. For image/pages, bounded copy/hash/fullWIC validation then durable controlled rename per fresh opaque version; ordered whole-batch manifest is only committed when every page succeeds.

Before finish, recheck exact original lease/control generation and request checkpoint; writer rereads node/profile/current pendingA/expected revision/latestSequence. AdmissionB supersedesA even ifB later fails;A can never become current again.

One transaction moves current→previous, drops only the displaced old previous references, installs new current with its own revision and resets page consistently, writes command result/digest, updates primary accounting and publishes authority.

Known precommit rejection cleans only this uncommitted preparation after actual handle/worker release. Any COMMIT/postpublication/response ambiguity retains sources and ownership/accounting until bounded startup/reconciliation proves state; never delete a potentially committed image.

On clear/undo/layout node deletion, keep stable scoped IDs and explicit resource-reference retention semantics. Layout removal must not let a stale preparation recreate content or reuse a retired node ID. Define how removed-node retained content appears in global cleanup/history rather than leaking indefinitely.

resourceAndCacheAccounting.primary: Independent profile-media originals1GiB; classroom-material original2GiB and launchcopies200MiB remain separate. Include current, previous, failed/unreferenced, retiring and in-progress bytes until real cleanup confirms release.
resourceAndCacheAccounting.criticalLifetime: Pending/admission TTL only revokes publication. It must not return physical preparation or byte quota while an old worker/file is still alive; otherwise two50-page500MiB batches can exceed1GiB after TTL/replacement. Physical tokens and byte owners survive until actual worker/handle cleanup.
resourceAndCacheAccounting.memoryImageCache: 32MiB explicit owned image-pixel cache, one decoder, bounded current-page/at-most-small-prefetch policy. Reserve before allocating, include actual pixel copies and WIC/D2D ownership; an8MP PBGRA image is32000000bytes so two full images cannot both fit.
resourceAndCacheAccounting.decodeWorkingSet: WIC may internally retain full original buffers; scanline/scaler APIs do not prove zero full-image allocation. Decoder working-set peaks plus target pixels, old/new caches and renderer surfaces must remain visible in global160MiB transient evidence.
resourceAndCacheAccounting.diskCache: 200MiB rebuildable derived cache with versioned key{media_id/hash,target_pixels,DPI,fit/orientation,format/algorithm}. LRU only unpinned derived entries; active content originals cannot be evicted to meet the cache quota.
resourceAndCacheAccounting.nativeBudget: 16MiB application RGBA/DIB admission remains unchanged. Resample to the actual target rectangle, account any D2D bitmap copy/scratch as well as outputDIB, and do not allocate an entire original-page set or full-screen preview intermediate.
resourceAndCacheAccounting.paths: Private controlled profile-media/{opaque version} sources and separate cache namespace, canonical path derived by trusted adapter only; no Scene/DTO user path, URL, UNC or shell open.

factsAndSceneBoundary.selection: Inside the same writer transaction select only activePublic content inside its outlet fallback plus the at-most-one exact Subject tree chosen by profiles::select; query only referenced active node slots, not all profile bodies.
factsAndSceneBoundary.snapshot: PublishedContentSnapshot exposes current version/content revision/view revision/page only; never pending/history/private raw input. Current display access uses trusted local scene-source proof and HealthGate, not a fabricated administrator actor.
factsAndSceneBoundary.budgetConcern: Existing Facts has2MiB response and64KiB individual BLOB limits.64 separate10000-scalar texts can exceed2MiB. Freeze one explicit strategy: an immutable bounded manifest plus version-bound paged worker payload fetch under expected source revision, or defined aggregate admission with explicit Capacity. Never silently truncate full text or allocate all128 blobs before a cap check.
factsAndSceneBoundary.renderBundle: Scene carries typed content/media IDs, dimensions, page and styles. Prepared target-size pixels travel as a separate bounded owned raster bundle/cache lease keyed by those IDs; no native handles or filesystem paths enter domain/Scene.
factsAndSceneBoundary.wholeScene: Late reads/decodes carry original selected slot/content revision/page/source stamp. Publication discards the complete stale bundle on any lesson/profile/content/global authority change and performs the existing final generation/source-revision/health checks before each native upload/input.

strictRecovery: Old exactly recognized profile schema with onlyMaterials and no content_styles can map to an explicit empty content-style list. New schema missing refs/styles or unknown fields remains corruption; do not default malformed new documents to empty content/initial registration.

Catalog pages and slot/content/media references are checked bidirectionally at startup in bounded batches. Missing declared current/previous media, bad hash/size/type/dimensions or cross-scope ownership enters repair/failclosed; orphan files are not interpreted as registered content.

Current/previous immutable media references and refcounts/state/quota survive reopen. Unreferenced files are retired in writer, then exclusively deleted by worker, then finalized in writer; no filename-only scan deletes a valid reference.
Derived cache loss is rebuildable; original-source loss is a data-integrity failure. Both crash cases must remain distinct.
